_about: Corrections register for the publish finalize program, following Gray Matter's corrective-action protocol. One record per problem in corrections/<id>.md. A correction closes only with changed_files, regression_evidence and a named reviewer_approval. No record in this file is closed. Status vocabulary: open | closed. Owner decisions are marked decision_owner: owner. Merged records group related findings to fit the design map budget (docs/design/README.md, 9000 bytes).

corrections.problem: Life was opt-in behind a preview-named flag that defaulted off. OD18 makes Life the default root, and it is on main (PR #211). A second Week surface (WeekFocusSurface) is still in the tree, reachable only through a path that cannot run; OD19 deletes it in wave 2. Life and Classic also remove a responsibility differently (undoable Details delete versus confirmation).
corrections.decision_owner: decided: OD18 applied on main; OD19 open for wave 2

corrections.problem: Health had three values (#007AFF default role, #30B0C7 category, #0A84FF landing), and School shared #007AFF. OD21 makes Health teal #30B0C7 everywhere. corrections.decision_owner: decided: OD21 (Health teal #30B0C7 everywhere; landing sample updated in this PR; model.ts default in wave 2). OD23 keeps the accent gradient on the one lit action per surface. Native hardcoded values remain for lane A.
